description: The COLLATE clause in column definitions through the SQL surface - a collated column carries COLLATE '<spec>' inside its DESCRIBE TABLE type cell: single and multiple columns, type parameters, constraints/DEFAULT/COMMENT alongside, case-insensitive spec spelling, qualified names, CLONE preservation, IF NOT EXISTS, a retype must RESTATE the collation (dropping, changing or adding one is refused with both types QUOTED in the message), CLUSTER BY and table COMMENT alongside. Converted from features/ColumnCollationTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE test1 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8')
CREATE TABLE test2 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8', description VARCHAR COLLATE 'en-ci', code VARCHAR)

SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''UTF8'''), CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'DESCRIPTION', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''EN-CI'''), CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'CODE', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE test3 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(100) COLLATE 'en-cs')
CREATE TABLE test4 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR NOT NULL COLLATE 'utf8', email VARCHAR UNIQUE COLLATE 'fr-ci')

SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''UTF8'''), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "null?", NULL)), CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'EMAIL', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''FR-CI'''), MAX(IFF("name" = 'EMAIL', "unique key", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE test5 (id INTEGER, status VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8' DEFAULT 'active')
SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'STATUS', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''UTF8'''), MAX(IFF("name" = 'STATUS', "default", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE test6 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8' COMMENT 'User name')
SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''UTF8'''), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "comment", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE test7 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR COLLATE 'EN-CI')
CREATE TABLE collation_schema.test8 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8')
CREATE TABLE source (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8', description VARCHAR COLLATE 'en-cs')

SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''UTF8'''), CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'DESCRIPTION', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''EN-CS''') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test10 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8')
CREATE TABLE test11 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE 'utf8' DEFAULT 'unknown' COMMENT 'User name')

SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''UTF8'''), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "null?", NULL)), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "unique key", NULL)), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "default", NULL)), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "comment", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE test12 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE test13 (id INTEGER, varchar_col VARCHAR COLLATE 'utf8', text_col VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE 'en-cs', number_col NUMBER)

SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'VARCHAR_COL', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''UTF8'''), CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'TEXT_COL', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE ''EN-CS'''), CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'NUMBER_COL', "type", NULL))), 'COLLATE') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
